footer_bullets: Hybrid systems — solar plus lithium backup with ECG/grid and generator; not standalone off-grid unless engineered on survey.
Connected load ceilings assume ~0.85 power factor; stagger AC, iron, and heater — do not run all heavy loads at once.
Panel counts sized to each inverter at max DC/AC ratio (1.3) with 570 W modules — full load, not load-diversity reduction.
Storage uses stocked 16 kWh LiFePO₄ modules; site survey confirms module count and backup hours.
Larger projects receive engineered BOM, load analysis & formal quotation from Energy Precisions.
Payment: typically 30% deposit · 40% on delivery · 30% on commissioning (negotiable).
